旧机器里的新饭碗: A New Rice Bowl from an Old Machine

你白天上班，晚上练拆装。考过实操后，一家维修铺让你从接单做起。第一笔工钱买了一套: You work by day and practise taking machines apart at night. After passing the practical exam, a repair shop lets you start by taking orders. Your first pay buys a set of your own tools.

当年练拆装留下的笔记翻得起了毛边。新来的学徒问你故障在哪，你让他先听一听声音。: The notes from your old disassembly practice are worn at the edges. When the new apprentice asks where the fault is, you tell him to listen to the sound first.
同事的旧风扇坏了，你照着那本维修笔记修好了。没换成行，至少没白学。: A colleague's old fan breaks and you fix it from that repair notebook. You didn't change careers, but at least the learning wasn't wasted.
八平方米的试营业: A Trial Run in Eight Square Metres
小区门口空出一间小屋。货架、押金和试营业共 ¥8,000，网点不保证单量。: A small room has opened up at the compound gate. Shelves, deposit and the trial run total ¥8,000, and the outlet doesn't guarantee any volume.
你试营业后接到了稳定的代收单，才办手续离开原岗位。第一周总有人拿错件，你把货架重: After the trial run you get steady parcel-collection orders, and only then go through the formalities of leaving your old post. In the first week people keep taking the wrong parcel, so you renumber the shelves.
三个月的单量付不起租金。你清掉货架，损失了押金和布置费，回去照常上班。倒是认识了: Three months of volume can't cover the rent. You clear the shelves, lose the deposit and setup costs, and go back to work as usual. At least you've met half the compound.
有人搬家前专门来告别，说这些年总是你替他收包裹。你把最后一件递过去，门口又响起扫: Someone comes to say goodbye before moving, saying that you were always the one who took in his parcels all these years. You hand over the last one, and the scanner beeps at the door again.
路上还有邻居叫你一声站长。你笑着纠正，说早就不干了，对方仍顺手给你递了一袋橘子。: On the street a neighbour still calls you "Station Chief". You laugh and correct them, saying you quit long ago, and they still hand you a bag of oranges.

客户改了七遍，最后取消续单。电脑钱已经花了，你保住原工作，把软件练习留在周末。: The client demands seven rounds of revisions and finally cancels the follow-up order. The computer money is already spent, so you keep your old job and leave software practice for weekends.
当年的客户又发来需求。你先列工期和修改次数，再泡一杯茶，终于懂得给自己的时间标价: The client from back then sends another request. You first list the timeline and number of revisions, then make a cup of tea, finally understanding how to put a price on your own time.
部门临时要整理一批老资料，你用当年学的软件半天做完。同事问你在哪学的，你说交过一: The department suddenly needs a batch of old files sorted, and you finish in half a day with the software you learned back then. A colleague asks where you learned it, and you say you paid a bit of tuition.
夜校培训加实习要 ¥10,000。你得下班后挤时间，重新学那些报警代码。: Night school training plus an internship costs ¥10,000. You'll have to squeeze time after work to relearn all those alarm codes.
实习时你找出一个反复误报的接头。照护站给了你正式岗位，你办完离职手续，带着工具箱: During the internship you find a connector that keeps causing false alarms. The care centre offers you a regular post, and after completing your resignation, you report in with your toolbox.
最后一轮实操没过。钱花了，熬夜也是真的，你暂时留在原岗，把考题里不懂的地方一项项: You fail the final practical round. The money is spent and the late nights were real, so you stay at your old post for now and circle the points you didn't understand in the exam questions one by one.
照护员说机器昨晚终于没乱响。你检查完接头，轻轻合上柜门，隔壁的老人还在午睡。: The caregiver says the machine finally didn't go off randomly last night. After checking the connector, you quietly close the cabinet door, and the old person next door is still napping.
家里的辅助设备报警，你按笔记先查接线。修好以后，你把熬夜的书收起来，今天早点睡。: The assistive device at home sounds an alarm, and you check the wiring first according to your notes. Once it's fixed, you put away the books from those late nights and go to bed early today.
社区培训班邀你试讲。教材和录课共 ¥6,000，你得把自己会做的事讲明白。: A community training class invites you to give a trial lecture. Materials and recording cost ¥6,000, and you have to explain clearly what you know how to do.

学员带着自己做的成品回来，说照着你的步骤少走了弯路。你改掉教材里一处旧说法，又开: A student comes back with their own finished piece, saying your steps saved them detours. You fix one outdated statement in the materials and open another class.

这些年积下的手艺和工作经验，有人愿意听你讲。: With the skills and work experience you've built up over the years, some people are willing to hear what you have to say.
你以前认真学过的兴趣，这次有人想跟着你学。: This time someone wants to learn from you the hobby you once studied seriously.
